name: Song section
doc: Where the song is, from the features: intro / build / drop / breakdown (decided each `bars` bars from the bar before; src/core/songform.ts), as 0/1 signals that ramp over `fade` beats, plus the index and the loudness. Drive switches, crossfades and params from the song's structure.

change.doc: 1 on the boundary tick where the section changed

bars.doc: decide every N bars (on the fixed beat grid from tick 0)

fade.doc: beats the 0/1 signals take to ramp after a change
